provider: real Claude Agent SDK and managed Anthropic-compatible Provider; no fake responses
credential_scope: One existing managed credential version shared by three isolated processes. No rotation or new credential. Real multi-credential switching was not exercised; credential isolation evidence is exact binding, read-only mount and environment restoration.

host.memory_measurement: host sysctl unavailable in sandbox; Docker VM limits measured below

percentile_method: Linear interpolation; 3 and 6 samples. Descriptive observations, not a capacity guarantee or tail-latency SLO.
model_rate_limit_observation: No surfaced rate-limit error. Provider quotas and hidden SDK HTTP retries were not measured.

warmup.note: Job completed once; evidence collector repaired created_at lookup and reread persisted facts without another invocation.

fixture_corrections: Initial explicit fake-provider setting corrected to disabled before any Provider call.
Warmup result collection fixed to read created_at from persistence; existing successful invocation reused.
First parallel fixture did not expose file tools; retained as failed isolation evidence. Rerun verified actual SDK cwd and transparent canaries without changing tool permissions.

superseded_isolation_attempt.failure_reason: Fixture requested native file tools absent from the synthetic Agent policy. Marker echo did not prove filesystem isolation. Replaced with transparent canaries, actual SDK cwd verification and cleanup checks; no product permissions changed.

limitations: Synthetic short text on one host and one model only.
Sandbox isolation uses actual per-job SDK cwd, transparent canary files and cleanup; file tool integration is outside this load test.
Only SDK query spans are used for overlap; Provider-reported API duration is corroborating data, not a trace of remote server scheduling.
Cancelled execution stops local SDK; upstream processing or billing after cancellation cannot be observed.
post_run_fixture_maintenance: Added reusable bounded resource sampler and made historical fixture-correction evidence optional for clean future runs. Product code, real SDK observer and measured results unchanged; Ruff and compile checks passed.
